skill.name: dbs-content-risk-check
skill.description: 面向创作者的内容发布风险检查。逐句检查自媒体、社交媒体和内容平台的标题、正文、图片文字、字幕、口播、评论、账号资料及视频画面，分别判断平台机器可能识别什么、内容本身存在什么实质问题，并给出具体位置和最小修改动作；需要明确视频语境边界时，额外生成真实准确的三行贴片小字。用户询问「检查敏感词」「发布前排雷」「这篇内容哪里可能违规」「这条小红书能不能发」「视频上放什么声明」时使用。保留强观点、情绪张力、个人风格和传播钩子。
skill.summary: Review publication risks, distinguish automated moderation signals from substantive problems, and suggest minimal edits.
skill.author: dontbesilent2025

content.value_statement: Creators need to distinguish automated moderation signals from substantive publication problems. This skill identifies specific concerns and suggests minimal edits while preserving personal expression.
actual_capabilities: Separates possible automated moderation triggers from substantive concerns such as misleading claims, privacy exposure, and restricted promotion.
Identifies specific wording or visible details and recommends targeted deletions, clarifications, evidence, disclosures, or permitted publication routes.
Guides review of supplied titles, captions, OCR text, scripts, comments, profiles, images, and accessible video material.
Drafts three-line video overlay text when truthful context boundaries are necessary or explicitly requested.
Directs current-policy checks toward official platform sources when a conclusion depends on changing rules.
limitations: Does not guarantee publication approval, reach, moderation outcomes, or appeal success.
Does not provide legal advice or replace platform review, professional counsel, or qualification checks.
Cannot assess missing images, audio, profiles, comments, or hidden platform signals; media review depends on host capabilities.
Provides overlay wording only, not generated images; current-policy verification requires access to official sources.

use_cases.title: Review a Social Post
use_cases.description: Locate potential problems in a caption and distinguish machine triggers from actual misleading or harmful statements.

use_cases.title: Check Promotional Claims
use_cases.description: Review product claims, commercial relationships, supporting evidence, and contact routes before publishing sponsored content.

use_cases.title: Clarify Video Context
use_cases.description: Check a supplied script and accessible footage, then draft truthful overlay text when personal experiences could be mistaken for guarantees.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Check this draft for publication risks on [platform]: [draft]. Separate possible machine triggers from substantive problems and suggest only necessary local edits.

prompt_templates.title: Check Commercial Content
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this promotional post for [platform]: [post]. Product category: [category]. Commercial relationship: [relationship]. Available evidence: [evidence]. Identify missing disclosures and unsupported claims.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: review advertising context and evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Review Video Materials
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these video materials for [platform]: [materials]. Identify unchecked surfaces and necessary edits. Add truthful three-line overlay wording only if context requires it.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: assess multiple content surfaces and conditional overlay text.

prompt_templates.title: Verify Policy-Dependent Concerns
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this campaign for [platform]: [materials]. Check policy-dependent concerns against current official sources. Cite rule titles, dates, applicability, and links. State unresolved facts.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: evaluate a campaign using current official policy evidence.

output_examples.input: Review a promotional caption: This ordinary tea cures diabetes in seven days. No supporting evidence is supplied.
output: Possible machine trigger: the caption combines product promotion with an explicit disease-treatment claim.
Substantive concern: the caption promises a cure for diabetes without supporting evidence or an authorized medical indication.
Minimal change: remove the cure and timing claims. Use only verified product facts within the permitted scope.
Review boundary: images, account details, and comments were not supplied.

output_examples.input: Review a personal study video script and suggest three overlay lines. The author describes one week of personal practice without promising results.
output: No substantive problem is apparent in the supplied description. Personal experience can remain.
Review boundary: the footage and audio were not supplied.

best_practices: Provide the target platform, intended audience, commercial relationships, and available supporting evidence.
Supply the actual publication surfaces and distinguish original visuals from OCR transcripts.
Verify policy-dependent recommendations against current official rules and resolve missing qualifications before publishing.
anti_patterns: Treating a flagged keyword or machine signal as proof of a substantive violation.
Using disclaimers to preserve false claims, missing qualifications, undisclosed advertising, or privacy exposure.
Requesting altered spellings, hidden contact details, or coded comments to evade moderation.

faq.question: Does this skill guarantee that a platform will approve my post?
faq.answer: No. It identifies visible concerns and uncertainty but cannot predict or guarantee platform decisions.

faq.question: What materials can I submit?
faq.answer: Submit drafts, captions, OCR text, scripts, comments, profiles, images, or accessible video materials. Visual and audio inspection depends on the host tool.

faq.question: Will it rewrite my entire draft?
faq.answer: Not by default. It recommends local changes and preserves personal style unless you request a full rewrite.

faq.question: When does it produce video overlay text?
faq.answer: When requested or when truthful context boundaries are needed. Overlay text cannot replace corrections, evidence, disclosures, or qualifications.

faq.question: Does it automatically open links in my draft?
faq.answer: No. Draft links are reviewed as content by default. Explicit webpage review can expand scope, and policy-dependent questions may require official-source lookups.

faq.question: Can it verify current platform rules?
faq.answer: When official sources are accessible, it checks relevant current rules. Without official evidence, it must state the uncertainty rather than invent enforcement details.
